name: Geas
description: A creature you can see must make a Wisdom save or be charmed for 30 days (720 hours). Casting time is 1 minute, so an encounter cast is refused (casting time too long for an encounter). The 30-day timer does not fit the round counter, so there is no round expiry: the charm lasts until the caster's team harms the target or greater restoration ends it. 5d10 psychic damage on disobedience, language, a suicidal command ending the spell, dismiss, remove curse, wish, and the upcast durations are deferred.
